title: Cocooning
wikitext:
{{Infobox/Generic |image = Cocooning Example.gif }} '''Cocooning''' is a feature that allows killed [[Mobs]] to respawn. == Mechanics == Upon triggering a cocoon event, three egg sacs will appear where the mob was killed, shifting for several seconds. After {{green|6}} seconds, the killed mob will reappear at full {{hp|HP}}. Additionally, the following message will display: {{Dialogue|&a&lCAUGHT! &cYou cocooned a &6&c!}} The player who cocooned the mob will become its owner, regardless of the original mob's owner. If the killed mob could spawn as [[Runecrafting#Runic Mobs|Runic]]{{confirm}} or [[Corrupted Mobs|Corrupted]], the cocooned mob will also have a chance to have those traits too. The cocooned mob acts like a naturally spawned mob, and is eligible for [[Bestiary]], [[Drop Chance|mob drops]], and [[Slayer|Slayer XP]]. The original mob will still be able to naturally respawn while the cocooned mob is alive. Cocooning still works on mobs spawned from cocooning, allowing players to chain these events. == Increasing Cocoon Chance == * {{Item|The Primordial}} grants a {{green|10%}} chance to cocoon [[Slayer|Slayer Bosses]] and [[Slayer|Slayer Minibosses]]. * The [[Reforging#Bloodshot|Bloodshot]] reforge grants a {{green|2.5%}} chance to cocoon most non-boss mobs outside [[Dungeons]] and {{Zone|Kuudra's Hollow}}. * The [[Attributes#Cocoon Chance|Cocoon Chance]] [[Attributes|Attribute]] grants an additional {{green|+5%}} chance to cocoon [[Slayer|Slayer Bosses]] and [[Slayer|Slayer Minibosses]] when using {{Item|The Primordial}}. {{Sectionstub}} List of mobs that cannot be cocooned: *Mobs in [[Dungeons]] *{{MobSprite|Sven Pup}}s *{{MobSprite|Puddle Jumper}} *{{MobSprite|Zombuddy}} *{{MobSprite|Timestalk Clone}} *{{MobSprite|Sphinx}} *{{MobSprite|Siamese Lynx}} *{{MobSprite|Chickzilla}} *Any Dragon, including {{MobSprite|Ender Dragon}}, {{MobSprite|Reindrake}} and {{MobSprite|Withered Dragon}} *{{MobSprite|Bambuleaf}} and {{MobSprite|Mochibear}} *{{MobSprite|End Stone Protector}} *Most fish shard entities, like {{MobSprite|Lotusfish}} or {{MobSprite|Azure}} *Multi-layered mobs, like {{MobSprite|Scatha}} or {{MobSprite|Fire Eel}} {{confirm}} *{{MobSprite|Wiki Tiki}} and {{MobSprite|Wiki Tiki Laser Totem}} *{{MobSprite|Jockey Skeleton}} *Mobs riding other entities, like {{MobSprite|Rider of the Deep}}, cannot be cocooned, meaning only bottom part rolls for cocoon chance. *{{mt|Pest|Pests}}{{confirm}} *{{MobSprite|Hideonleaf}} *{{MobSprite|Primordial Bat}}, {{MobSprite|Primordial Hatchling}} and {{MobSprite|Primordial Minion}} *{{MobSprite|Rollim}} and {{MobSprite|Kaus}} Mobs that can be cocooned despite being bosses include: *Crimson Isle [[Minibosses]] and related entities, like {{MobSprite|Summoned Skull}}s (intended to be non-cocoonable, but this behavior is currently bugged) *{{MobSprite|Arachne}} == Interactions == * If the cocooned mob is a slayer boss, an additional "{{Red|'''YOU COCOONED YOUR SLAYER BOSS'''}}" appears in chat, and the next slayer quest skips the spawning phase as if the slayer boss has already spawned. == Gallery == Cocoon Render.png|A cocoon Cocoon.png|A cocoon segment Cocooning Example.gif|An example of a zombie being respawned == Bugs == * If the cocooned mob is a [[Sea Creature]], the cocooned mob will not be considered as a Sea Creature and can be damaged while the player is wearing [[Trophy Hunter Armor]]. Additionally, the damage buff towards sea creatures ability on the {{Item|Flaming Flay}} and the {{Item|Soul Whip}} will also not work. * If a [[Hidden Jerry]] is '''Cocooned''', it does not drop any loot upon being killed. == Trivia == * For mobs such as the {{MobSprite|Fiery Scuttler}} where multiple entities belong to one single [[Sea Creature]], all associated entities are eligible for a cocoon event. The cocoon also will spawn multiple entities instead of the single one that was cocooned. * If the cocooned mob was a '''Jawbus Follower''' summoned by {{MobSprite|Lord Jawbus}}, the cocooned mob will return to its original name instead of keeping the '''Jawbus Follower''' name. * The egg sacs bear a resemblance to the sacs that the {{MobSprite|Tarantula Broodfather}} spawns. * A cocooned {{MobSprite|Phantom Spirit}}{{confirm}} or {{MobSprite|Timestalk Clone}} (while it could still be cocooned) will randomly take an [[mcw:Alex|Alex]] or [[mcw:Steve|Steve]] skin. * While it is not normally possible to cocoon mobs in [[The Rift]] due to no {{Rift Transferable}} item or other mechanic existing to do so, if the player is somehow able to wear {{Item|The Primordial}} in the Rift, it is able to cocoon the {{MobSprite|Riftstalker Bloodfiend}}. ** This was verified on the [[Alpha Hypixel Network]] during the release of the feature with the help of {{NPCSprite|Centauri}}. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2025/Jul 8|[[File:The Primordial.png|26px]] Added '''[[The Primordial]]'''.|[[File:Shriveled Cornea.png|26px]] Added [[Shriveled Cornea]].}} {{History|2026/Apr 30|Added a message when '''Cocooning''' a [[Mob]].}} |beta= {{History|0.23.2|[[File:The Primordial.png|26px]] Added [[The Primordial]].|[[File:Shriveled Cornea.png|26px]] Added [[Shriveled Cornea]].}} {{History|2025/Jul 10|link=none|Disabled '''Cocooning'''.}} {{History|2026/Jan 12|Re-enabled '''Cocooning'''.}} {{History|2026/May 6|Added a message when '''Cocooning''' a [[Mob]].|'''Cocooned''' mobs now belong to the player who cocooned them|}} }} == References == {{Cite Discord | url = https://discord.com/channels/651912910972649492/1529181650641228007/1529870627932999903 | staff = yes | user = mrkeith | date = July 23, 2026, 11:19 AM (EST) | text = the master list they both check are as follows:
